nusmp.skill.adolla_burst.description: Ultimate. Evolved from Devil's Footprints. Move at the speed of light striking everything on the way, kick with far more force, and unleash the Adolla Burst around you.
nusmp.skill.airiel.description: Unique. Tempest: wrap yourself in wind for speed, power and protection from arrows, or ride it in a sudden dash that recovers faster while the wind blows.
nusmp.skill.all_fiction.description: Ultimate. Make injuries, enemies and even your own death never have happened.
nusmp.skill.arcs_ray.description: Chanted magic (1 line). A piercing beam of light strikes everything in a line, and burns the undead even harder.
nusmp.skill.argonaut.description: Unique. The wish to become a hero. Hold to charge with the chime of bells (up to five), release to strike everything in front of you.
nusmp.skill.black_wings.description: Ultimate. Toggle. Total reflection of melee and projectiles, no fall damage, and wings that let you glide in the air while you sneak.
nusmp.skill.book_maker.description: Unique. Pin your target with giant screws and drag it down to your level. Once mastered, Barrage pins every foe in front of you.
nusmp.skill.chant.arcs_ray.1: Arcs Ray: pierce them, arrow of light.
nusmp.skill.chant.futsunomitama.2: Futsunomitama: press them to the earth.
nusmp.skill.chant.rea_laevateinn.1: Flames of the dawn, rise from the ground.
nusmp.skill.chant.rea_laevateinn.2: Circle the one who calls you and burn all who approach.
nusmp.skill.chant.rea_laevateinn.3: Rea Laevateinn: let the pillars of fire arise.
nusmp.skill.chant.uchide_no_kozuchi.1: Little mallet of fortune, hear my prayer.
nusmp.skill.chant.uchide_no_kozuchi.2: Lend your strength to the one who stands before me.
nusmp.skill.chant.uchide_no_kozuchi.3: Uchide no Kozuchi: grow, and rise above yourself.
nusmp.skill.chant.wynn_fimbulvetr.1: Winter's breath, come to my call.
nusmp.skill.chant.wynn_fimbulvetr.2: Let the frozen sky fall and the world turn white.
nusmp.skill.chant.wynn_fimbulvetr.3: Wynn Fimbulvetr: freeze everything that lives.
nusmp.skill.devils_footprints.descriptio: Unique. Flames burst from your feet: dash through the air or deliver a burning kick. Your own fire cannot hurt you.
nusmp.skill.faith.description: Unique. Pray to gather Faith, then spend it to bestow a skill upon a player you look at. Faith is kept when this skill evolves.
nusmp.skill.firebolt.description: Instant magic. A bolt of lightning-fire fired the moment you press, striking what you look at and scorching everything near it. Mastery doubles the damage.
nusmp.skill.freya.description: Unique. Goddess of Beauty. Your Charm makes nearby monsters forget you and leaves your enemies dazed.
nusmp.skill.futsunomitama.description: Chanted magic (2 lines). A gravity field at the spot you look at crushes foes down, pulls them in and pins them.
nusmp.skill.goddess_of_faith.description: Ultimate. Evolved from Faith. Bestow for half the Faith and half the wait, pray for triple Faith, grant allies a Blessing, and work a Miracle that heals and protects them.
nusmp.skill.gold_experience.description: Unique. Give life to heal an ally, or overload a foe's senses with it; your blows leave enemies slowed.
nusmp.skill.gold_experience_requiem.desc: Ultimate. Return to Zero: attacks against you never reach their result. Life Burst floods your allies with life.
nusmp.skill.hati.description: Unique. Passive. Fire, lightning and magic hitting you are partly absorbed and turned into stacking Strength.
nusmp.skill.hawk_eye.description: Toggle. Bird Card sight: night vision, and every hostile creature around you glows, even through walls.
nusmp.skill.hell_conqueror.description: Ultimate. Toggle. Evolved from Hell Walker. Near death your blows become devastating and heal you, and a hellfire aura burns the foes around you.
nusmp.skill.hell_walker.description: Unique. Toggle. The closer you are to death, the harder you hit: at ten percent health your blows deal about double.
nusmp.skill.hephaestus.description: Unique. Goddess of the Forge. Restore the weapon in your hand, and your off-hand and armour once mastered.
nusmp.skill.heros_argonaut.description: Ultimate. Evolved from Argonaut. Charge up to ten bells and strike with triple power, or release the charge as a piercing Hero's Beam.
nusmp.skill.hestia.description: Unique. Goddess of the Hearth. Heal and bless yourself and every ally around you; once mastered it also cleanses and wards off fire.
nusmp.skill.immortal_will.description: Ultimate. Evolved from Unbreakable Will. Rise from a killing blow at full health, far more often, with a shockwave; Rally heals and cleanses you on demand.
nusmp.skill.instant_death.description: Ultimate. Whatever you will to die, dies. Bosses and protected players lose a share of their health instead.
nusmp.skill.liaris_freese.description: Unique. Passive. While your feelings remain, so does your growth: your kills can raise the mastery of all your skills.
nusmp.skill.limitless.description: Ultimate. Infinity stops every attack before it reaches you. Blue, Red and Hollow Purple bend space itself.
nusmp.skill.loki.description: Unique. The Trickster. Vanish from sight and blink forward; monsters that were hunting you lose track of you.
nusmp.skill.lord_of_summons.description: Ultimate. Evolved from Summoner. Twice the summons and far stronger cards: Beast Card calls three wolves, Stone Card is a colossus, Legion calls a pack of five and the Wraith Card a swarm of flying spirits.
nusmp.skill.msg.almighty.cooldown: That future is not yet visible.
nusmp.skill.msg.bookmaker.locked: Master Book Maker to unlock Barrage.
nusmp.skill.msg.evolution.confirmed: Confirmed. %s's Unique Skill %s has evolved into the Ultimate Skill %s.
nusmp.skill.msg.evolution.needs_ep: Your mastered %s wants to evolve, but your soul needs %s EP.
nusmp.skill.msg.faith.divine_cooldown: The goddess has not yet recovered.
nusmp.skill.msg.faith.has_all: %s already has every skill you can bestow.
nusmp.skill.msg.faith.miracle: A miracle: your allies are healed and protected.
nusmp.skill.msg.faith.no_target: Look at a player to bestow.
nusmp.skill.msg.god.cooldown: This divine power is on cooldown.
nusmp.skill.msg.liaris.status: Liaris Freese: your skills have grown %s times.
nusmp.skill.msg.magic.ready: The chant is complete: release to cast.
nusmp.skill.msg.summoner.cap: You can only have %s summons at once.
nusmp.skill.msg.summoner.lord_only: Only the Lord of Summons can call this card.
nusmp.skill.msg.will.recovering: Your will is still recovering (%s s).
nusmp.skill.rea_laevateinn.description: Chanted magic (3 lines). Wave after wave of flame pillars erupt around you and burn every foe that comes close.
nusmp.skill.six_eyes.description: Unique. Toggle. See every living thing around you through walls and darkness, and read the health of whatever you look at.
nusmp.skill.spirit_card.description: Toggle. A healing aura for you and everyone near you; once mastered it also cleanses harmful effects.
nusmp.skill.summoner.description: Unique. Call summon cards: a Beast Card wolf or a Stone Card golem fight beside you, Recall dismisses them. Mastery raises how many can answer.
nusmp.skill.the_almighty.description: Ultimate. See every future and choose the one where you are never harmed.
nusmp.skill.the_visionary.description: Ultimate. Whatever you imagine becomes reality: a meteor, a void, a perfect body.
nusmp.skill.uchide_no_kozuchi.descriptio: Chanted magic (3 lines). Level Boost: greatly raise the power of the ally you look at, or your own, for a time.
nusmp.skill.unbreakable_will.description: Unique. Passive. Once in a long while, survive a killing blow and stand back up. Press to see whether your will is ready.
nusmp.skill.vector_manipulation.descript: Unique. Toggle. Reflect projectiles and turn part of every melee hit back on the attacker.
nusmp.skill.wynn_fimbulvetr.description: Chanted magic (3 lines). A blizzard falls on the spot you look at: it freezes everything in it and keeps chilling whatever stays.
